title: Present-day ice: Natural Earth 10 m glaciated areas and Antarctic ice shelves
license: Public domain (Natural Earth terms of use)
note: Only the present day. Grounded ice (glaciers and ice sheets) and the floating Antarctic ice shelves as polygons in longitude/latitude; the builder rasterises them onto the 0 Ma stop's texture grid. No open source gives ice outlines through the Phanerozoic; see issue #7 for what the van der Meer 2022 table offers instead.
